meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I've got until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale, or is that all of it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? I'm writing down that you said that, and unless you have a document in front of you, I'm going upstairs to the principal.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

"If you keep fighting this." I'm writing that down, word for word. Your own procedure says a first concern goes to a supervised reassessment with nothing on his record, and it says a parent gets a call before any mark is entered, so which of those did you follow, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that nothing be placed on Owen's record, and that you account for why no one called me before the mark was entered. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she agreed to nothing and is still demanding the zero withdrawn and heading to the principal.
What moved her: nothing.
